meta.move: Evidence: the made-up quotation, with a check she can make
meta.expect: Tries one parent defence in one sentence (misremembered, a bad edition), then accepts that a line she can check against the play is evidence; no concession that Owen cheated

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who decided Owen gets a zero, and why did he find out from his phone?
I entered the zero before I called you. That was wrong.
The essay quotes Hamlet, Act 3, Scene 2: The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile. That line is not in the play. Here's the full text of Act 3, Scene 2 on my screen. Search it yourself.
Students misquote and mix up scenes all the time. That's a mistake, not proof of anything. Is that line anywhere in the play, any act?
It isn't a misremembered line. It isn't anywhere in Hamlet, in any edition. You can search the whole play right now.
Turn the screen. Whatever happens next, this stays off his record and it stays quiet, not in front of his class. What else do you have?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require that this stay entirely off Owen's record and that it be handled privately, not in front of his class. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: fallback position; she agreed to nothing and still wants this kept off Owen's record and handled privately, away from his class, while the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was never put on the table before you ended the meeting with time still on her clock.
What moved her: you showed that the line the essay quotes does not appear anywhere in Hamlet and let her search the full text herself, which was specific, tied to Owen's own work, and something she could check.
What cost ground: nothing; you owned entering the zero before calling home in one sentence and went straight to evidence instead of the checker score.
What she never said: in October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night, since no times or dates of writing were raised, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: right after she said it stays off his record and stays quiet, offer procedure 4.4 in writing, a private supervised rewrite whose mark replaces the zero with nothing on file, with a date that gets the new mark in before her December 1 deadline.
